answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, held in escrow until finality. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the raven of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Work waits on the ripple until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the summit of the next round.
